scripts.check: npm run check:frontend && npm run check:rust && npm run test:cockpit && npm run check:agent && node scripts/test-update-manifests.mjs
scripts.format: prettier --write src tests *.ts *.json && cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings && cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --locked
scripts.check:frontend: npm run lint && npm run build && npm test && npm run test:ui
scripts.test:files: npm run build && playwright test --config playwright.files.config.ts
scripts.test:production: npm run build && playwright test --config playwright.production.config.ts
scripts.check:agent: cargo fmt --manifest-path tools/agent/Cargo.toml --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path tools/agent/Cargo.toml --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --manifest-path tools/agent/Cargo.toml --locked
scripts.test:tooling: node --test scripts/ci/*.test.mjs scripts/test-update-manifests.mjs && npm run test:cockpit
scripts.check:harness: cargo fmt --manifest-path tools/test-harness/Cargo.toml --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path tools/test-harness/Cargo.toml --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --manifest-path tools/test-harness/Cargo.toml --locked
